policy.pull_request_rule: Pull requests run deterministic contract, fixture, binding, and harness-plan checks that do not require hardware.
policy.manual_release_gate_rule: workflow_dispatch can run the Docker :48027 smoke harness when a maintainer requests release-gate evidence.
policy.artifact_rule: Platform package jobs must attach build artifacts, SBOM outputs, and provenance or attestation evidence before beta or stable release claims.
policy.secret_rule: Signing, store, notarization, and deployment credentials stay in CI secrets or platform stores and are never checked into the repository.

jobs.purpose: Fail route, helper, adapter, and generated-binding readiness drift before platform jobs start.
Fail any fixture pack drift that would make downstream client test baselines inconsistent.
Keep generation-practical targets aligned until server-emitted OpenAPI/JSON Schema output exists.
Run the shared web/Tauri build smoke path before desktop packaging lanes.
Run Dart/Flutter dependency, lint, test, and Android debug build smoke checks.
Keep TV/console platform phases on the shared fixture baseline before hardware execution.
Build the native Android TV debug APK and fail fixture, API, playback, auth, deep-link, accessibility, diagnostics, lint, or unit-test drift.
On maintainer request, boot an Android TV AVD and verify debug APK installation, Leanback launcher entry, and custom playback deep-link handoff.
Verify the Docker smoke harness plan, seed profile, and required verifier commands on every contract-changing PR.
Start Docker, seed representative data, probe :48027, run contract/conformance verifiers, and tear down for release-gate evidence.
